title: M6.8 earthquake near JASM = TSMC fab in Japan
gist: A SemiWiki forum thread started 2026-07-28 reports a magnitude 6.8 earthquake near JASM, identified as TSMC's fab in Japan, with two image attachments and no replies. Note the discrepancy between the headline event and the record's body: the captured text is almost entirely site navigation and registration boilerplate, and contains no damage assessment, fab status or production impact.
